rules.sql_text: SELECT 1 FROM t WHERE t.CHANNEL = 'CASH' AND t.DIRECTION = 'CREDIT' AND t.AMOUNT_INR BETWEEN 900000 AND 999999 AND t.TXN_TS >= DATEADD('day', -30, x) GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
rules.plain_english: Flags incoming cash transactions between ₹9 L and ₹10 L 3 or more times in the last 30 days.
rules.plain_hindi: पिछले 30 दिनों में ₹9 लाख से ₹10 लाख के बीच के आने वाले नकद लेनदेन (3 या ज़्यादा बार) पर अलर्ट बनाता है।
rules.source_quote: All attempts of cash deposits in amounts ranging from Rs. 9,00,000 to Rs. 9,99,999 conducted more than three times in a rolling 30-day period by the same customer or linked accounts shall be flagged as potential structuring and reported as STR.
